tasks.label: BidProof: 0 — Infra up (Docker)
tasks.detail: Postgres, Redis, MinIO, ClickHouse, Langfuse, LiteLLM. Run once; leave running.

tasks.label: BidProof: 1 — API (port 8000)
tasks.detail: FastAPI with --reload, so code edits are picked up without a restart.
tasks.command: python -m uv run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000

tasks.label: BidProof: 2 — Web (port 5173)
tasks.detail: Vite dev server. Open http://localhost:5173 once it is up.

tasks.label: BidProof: servers (API + Web together)
tasks.detail: Helper for the DEMO task: starts both servers at once.

tasks.label: BidProof: DEMO — start everything
tasks.detail: Infra first (it finishes), then API and Web side by side. Press this before a demo.

tasks.label: BidProof: Inspect a PDF (what the reader saw)
tasks.detail: Step-0 routing + per-page result + sample text with boxes. Touches no data.
tasks.command: python -m uv run --project apps/api python tools/inspect_pdf.py "${input:pdfPath}" --pages ${input:pdfPages} --text

tasks.label: BidProof: Company data (what we know about them)
tasks.detail: Facts, products and their sources — plus what is missing. Read-only.
tasks.command: python -m uv run --project apps/api python tools/show_company.py --company "${input:companyName}"

tasks.label: BidProof: Company gaps (why rules need a human)
tasks.detail: Just the missing fields — the short version.
tasks.command: python -m uv run --project apps/api python tools/show_company.py --company "${input:companyName}" --gaps

tasks.label: BidProof: Tests (fast, no Docker needed)
tasks.command: python -m uv run --project apps/api python -m pytest -m "not integration" -q
tasks.detail: Unit tests only. Safe: does NOT touch your database.

tasks.label: BidProof: Tests (full) — WIPES YOUR DEMO DATA
tasks.detail: Integration fixtures TRUNCATE organizations and tenders. Run 'Reseed demo data' afterwards.
tasks.command: python -m uv run --project apps/api python -m pytest -q

tasks.label: BidProof: Reseed demo data (Godrej)
tasks.detail: Restores the org, company facts and product catalogue after a full test run.
tasks.command: python -m uv run --project apps/api python infra/seed/seed_godrej_public.py

tasks.label: BidProof: Infra down
tasks.detail: Stops the containers. Your data survives — it lives in Docker volumes.

inputs.description: Full path to the PDF to inspect
Which pages? e.g. 1-5 or 2,7 (a big tender takes minutes if you ask for all)
Company name (part of it is enough; blank shows all)
